c74object.name: evi_controlcircuit_buchla
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Control circuit for voltage control of Rf
c74object.description:
evi_controlcircuit_buchla is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_controlcircuit_buchla.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
Analog modelled control circuit for the voltage control of the evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp frequency inlet. Also embedded in the MSP abstraction evi.lpg~.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ v_c, offset, scale, sweep } }

geninlet.name: v_c
geninlet.digest: (from Vactrol). Triggering envelope, typically from evi_vactrol.gendsp.

geninlet.name: offset
geninlet.digest: @min 0 @max 1 @default 0.1. 0..1 Offset (add to) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

geninlet.name: scale
geninlet.digest: @min 0 @max 1 @default 0.48. 0..1 Scale (multiply) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

geninlet.name: sweep
geninlet.digest: @min 0 @max 1 @default 0.591859. 0..1. Amount of sweep range of the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

attribute.name: control
attribute.description: Select 0, 1, 2. Subtle. This control switches between slow..long response times for the voltage input into the control circuit shaper. It is only noticeable with high control and resonance settings

attribute.name: mapcutoff
attribute.description: Low shelving filter frequency, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). Typically this would be set to low Hz values (perhaps 5..20) for maximum effect. This filter mapping is controlled by the @mapdamp attribute and is by default off.

attribute.name: mapdamp
attribute.description: Low shelving filter damp, optionally maps between V_c (vactrol) and V_b (filter cutoff voltage). 0 = no damping (default, bypassed), 1 = fully damped. Under the right settings, this attribute can have a strong affect on the attack feeling of the gate voltage. A higher damping value 'softens' the attack at the filter stage rather than in the envelope stage. This can add a squidgy sound the is rather cool. The mapping filter frequency is set by the @mapcutoff attribute.

attribute.name: offsetsmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'offset' control (inlet 2) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: scalesmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'scale' control (inlet 3) by this amount in ms.

attribute.name: sweepsmooth
attribute.description: If > 0, smooths the 'sweep' control (inlet 4) by this amount in ms.
